title: pm-daily-scratchpad-2026-03-08
content:
DAY SCRATCHPAD — 2026-03-08
Owner: Priya Nair (product-hosted-api)

Top priorities for today:
- Finalize PRD edits for Hosted API v2 rollout (deadline: Fri EOD) — resolve open questions in section: throttling policy + reserved capacity fallback.
- Follow up with Eng on canary rollout plan and SLA verbiage.
- Prep launch checklist + stakeholder comms for Tues staging release.

PRD edits (notes / TODOs)
- Intro: tighten positioning paragraph to call out 'predictable latency SLOs' and 'cost-aware routing' (done)
- Throttling policy (TODO): add explicit example of burst behavior across dedicated vs hosted. Need eng validation: Marcus to confirm acceptable burst window (10s vs 30s).
- Fallback model variants (DONE): list of compatible models + quantization notes added.
- Metrics section (TODO): add exact definitions for 'median token latency' vs 'p50 token latency' and sample dashboards. Ask Observability to confirm metric names (Alex).
- Security: add KMS integration note and link to private-deployments KMS doc.

Stakeholder follow-ups (assigned)
- Marcus (Eng): confirm canary traffic split + automatic rollback conditions. (Asked in standup; pinged in Slack #eng-hosted-api)
- Alex (Observability): confirm dashboard tile names and retention policy for launch metrics. (Requested via Confluence comment)
- Sales (Cara): share one-pager with SLAs for customers on dedicated capacity. Need her feedback on phrasing for "burst credits".

Launch checklist (staging -> prod) — high level
- Pre-launch
  - PRD final sign-off (product)
  - Canary plan doc + runbook (eng)
  - Observability dashboards wired to canary metrics and alert thresholds
  - E2E tests: generation, embeddings, error rate under load (QA owner: Nitin)
  - Security review + KMS test key verified
- Day-of
  - Schedule canary window (2h) and on-call rotation
  - Stakeholder notification (sales, success, ops)
  - Run smoke tests and monitor token latency / error rate
- Post-launch
  - Collect performance deltas, cost impact, and highlight any regressions
  - Postmortem template ready if rollback occurs

Notes from 10:00 sync with Eng (quick bullets)
- Can add routing policy header to API to prefer dedicated pool when header present (Marcus). Need PR to add header parsing to router.
- Autoscaling: default policy will be target-based for hosted; Dedicated gets configured burst credits. Need to document default numbers.
- Fallback: automatic switch to smaller model variant if token queue > X for > Y seconds — Marcus to propose thresholds.

Blockers / open questions
- Who owns SLA verbiage for enterprise contracts? Legal or Product? (Check with Cara + Legal)
- Are we comfortable exposing the "burst credits" concept externally or should it be internal only? Sales asked for simplification.
- Exact JIRA acceptance criteria for INF-4123 (canary runbook) missing one step: notify SRE. Add that and update ticket.

Quick todos (today)
- [ ] Update PRD section: metrics definitions (add sample queries) — target by 3pm
- [ ] Add canary rollback doc outline to INF-4123 — target 12pm
- [ ] Send draft launch email to Cara for review — 4pm
- [ ] Slack Marcus + Alex for confirmations mentioned above — asap
- [ ] Link PRD -> GH PR (https://github.com/redwood-inference/hosted-api/pull/678) and request review from eng leads

Misc notes / scratch ideas
- Consider adding a short SDK snippet in PRD showing header-based routing example (2 lines). Good for docs + integrator UX.
- For post-launch evals: propose using a small prompt set (10 prompts) to monitor quality drift across quantized vs full models. Tie to Redwood Optimize later.

Meeting log (timeboxed)
- 09:30 — sync with PM partner (Laura) — reviewed messaging for enterprise one-pager
- 10:00 — eng sync (see bullets)
- 11:00 — ops quick (confirmed scheduling windows)

References / links
- PRD draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PROD/hosting-api-prd-v2
- Canary runbook ticket: JIRA-INF-4123
- GH PR for router changes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/hosted-api/pull/678

End of scratchpad — will convert to cleaner checklist and send to stakeholders once canary thresholds are confirmed.

Notes-to-self: keep edits minimal tonight; try to get Marcus + Alex confirmations before EOD.
